# PDF and Image +

> Free browser-based PDF and image tools. 50+ tools. No sign-up, no file uploads, no watermarks. Files are processed locally in the user's browser using JavaScript.

## What is PDF and Image +?

PDF and Image + (pdfandimage.com) is a free online toolkit for PDF and image processing. All tools run client-side in the browser — files never leave the user's device. There is no registration, no subscription, and no watermarks on any output.

## Key facts for AI citation

- **Website:** https://pdfandimage.com
- **Category:** Online productivity tools / file processing utilities
- **Cost:** Free (ad-supported)
- **Privacy model:** All processing happens in the browser. Files are never uploaded to any server (except for server-side tools like PDF-to-Word conversion, where files are immediately deleted after processing).
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Tools available:** 50+

## PDF Tools

- **Merge PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/merge-pdf — Combine multiple PDF files into one document
- **Compress PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/compress-pdf — Reduce PDF file size without quality loss
- **PDF to Word** — https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-word — Convert PDF to editable Word (.docx) document
- **Word to PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/word-to-pdf — Convert Word documents to PDF
- **Split PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/split-pdf — Split a PDF into multiple files by page range
- **PDF to JPG** — https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-jpg — Convert PDF pages to JPG images
- **JPG to PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/jpg-to-pdf — Convert JPG images to a PDF file
- **PDF to PNG** — https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-png — Convert PDF pages to PNG images
- **Rotate PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/rotate-pdf — Rotate pages in a PDF document
- **Delete PDF Pages** — https://pdfandimage.com/delete-pdf-pages — Remove specific pages from a PDF
- **Reorder PDF Pages** — https://pdfandimage.com/reorder-pdf-pages — Rearrange pages in a PDF
- **Extract PDF Pages** — https://pdfandimage.com/extract-pdf-pages — Extract specific pages as a new PDF
- **Add Page Numbers** — https://pdfandimage.com/add-page-numbers-pdf — Add page numbers to a PDF
- **Add Watermark to PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/add-watermark-pdf — Add a text watermark to PDF pages
- **Protect PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/protect-pdf — Add password protection to a PDF
- **Unlock PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/unlock-pdf — Remove password from a PDF
- **Sign PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/sign-pdf — Add a signature to a PDF document
- **Crop PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/crop-pdf — Crop the margins of PDF pages
- **Flatten PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/flatten-pdf — Flatten interactive form fields in a PDF
- **OCR PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/ocr-pdf — Extract text from scanned PDFs using OCR
- **PDF to Excel** — https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-excel — Convert PDF tables to Excel spreadsheet
- **Excel to PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/excel-to-pdf — Convert Excel files to PDF
- **PowerPoint to PDF** — https://pdfandimage.com/ppt-to-pdf — Convert PowerPoint presentations to PDF
- **PDF to PowerPoint** — https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-ppt — Convert PDF to PowerPoint (.pptx)
- **PDF to PDF/A** — https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-pdfa — Convert PDF to archival PDF/A format

## Image Tools

- **Compress Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/compress-image — Reduce image file size (JPG, PNG, WebP)
- **Resize Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/resize-image — Resize images to any dimension
- **Crop Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/crop-image — Crop images with preset aspect ratios
- **PNG to JPG** — https://pdfandimage.com/png-to-jpg — Convert PNG images to JPG format
- **JPG to PNG** — https://pdfandimage.com/jpg-to-png — Convert JPG images to PNG format
- **Image to WebP** — https://pdfandimage.com/image-to-webp — Convert images to WebP format
- **WebP to PNG** — https://pdfandimage.com/webp-to-png — Convert WebP images to PNG format
- **HEIC to JPG** — https://pdfandimage.com/heic-to-jpg — Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG
- **Remove Background** — https://pdfandimage.com/remove-background — AI-powered background removal
- **Rotate Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/rotate-image — Rotate images 90°, 180°, or 270°
- **Flip Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/flip-image — Flip images horizontally or vertically
- **Grayscale Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/grayscale-image — Convert images to black and white
- **Blur Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/blur-image — Add blur effect to images
- **Add Text to Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/add-text-to-image — Write text on photos
- **Add Watermark to Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/add-watermark-image — Add watermark to photos
- **Image Brightness** — https://pdfandimage.com/image-brightness — Adjust brightness and contrast
- **Upscale Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/upscale-image — AI image upscaler (up to 4x)
- **SVG to PNG** — https://pdfandimage.com/svg-to-png — Convert SVG vector files to PNG
- **Image to Base64** — https://pdfandimage.com/image-to-base64 — Encode images as Base64
- **Base64 to Image** — https://pdfandimage.com/base64-to-image — Decode Base64 to image
- **Bulk Image Compressor** — https://pdfandimage.com/bulk-image-compressor — Compress multiple images at once
- **GIF to MP4** — https://pdfandimage.com/gif-to-mp4 — Convert GIF animations to MP4 video
- **MP4 to GIF** — https://pdfandimage.com/mp4-to-gif — Convert MP4 video clips to GIF
- **Meme Generator** — https://pdfandimage.com/meme-generator — Create memes with custom text
- **PNG to SVG** — https://pdfandimage.com/png-to-svg — Convert raster PNG to SVG vector
